description: AI-powered invoice capture and three-way matching that reads supplier invoices, matches them against POs and goods receipts, and routes only exceptions to AP clerks for review.
justification: Bulk of keying and matching is automatable; clerks still review flagged exceptions and approve payments.

description: A customer-facing conversational assistant that answers routine order-status and delivery-tracking questions directly from the OMS and carrier feeds, escalating only complex cases to agents.
justification: Order-status questions are highly repetitive and the underlying data is already structured, so most can be fully deflected.

description: An AI quoting assistant that drafts quotes with recommended pricing and discount levels from price lists, contract terms and historical quotes, for the sales rep to validate and send.
justification: Drafting and pricing lookups are automated, but reps still adjust and approve non-standard or large RFQs.

description: An AI tool that screens and ranks incoming CVs against role requirements to produce a shortlist for recruiters to review before any interview decision.
justification: Initial screening is automated, but recruiters still manually review every AI-shortlisted and borderline CV before deciding.

description: An AI-assisted consolidation tool that aggregates entity-level P&L/GL extracts, flags variances automatically, and drafts narrative commentary for the controller to review and finalize.
justification: Aggregation and first-draft commentary are automated, but the controller still reviews and signs off every monthly close.
